property_summary: For any address account and token id, balanceOf(account,id) on the correct contract never reverts for non-zero accounts and returns the stored balance; the mutant inverts the zero-address check so non-zero accounts revert (or return differing values), therefore there exists some (non-zero) account and id where the reference returns a value but the mutant either reverts or returns a different value.
change_summary: Invert the zero-address check so that calling balanceOf with a non-zero account reverts instead, changing returned values for any normal account.
